  FROM store.inventory_book ib

),

  FROM store.forecasts f
  WHERE f.date BETWEEN '2026-06-01' AND '2026-06-28'
  GROUP BY f.sku
)
SELECT 
  sj.sku,
  sj.name,
  sj.pack,
  sj.total_units,
  sj.total_revenue,
  sj.unit_margin,
  sj.total_units * sj.unit_margin AS total_profit,
  COALESCE(sod.days_oos, 0) AS stockout_days,
  COALESCE(woq.total_writeoffs, 0) AS writeoff_units,
  fa.avg_forecast,
  CASE 
    WHEN sj.total_units = 0 THEN 'DROP - no sales'
    WHEN sj.unit_margin <= 0 THEN 'DROP - negative margin'
    WHEN sod.days_oos > 5 THEN 'REVIEW - frequent stockouts'
    WHEN woq.total_writeoffs > sj.total_units * 0.1 THEN 'REVIEW - high waste'
    ELSE 'KEEP'

FROM sales_june sj
LEFT JOIN stockout_days sod ON sj.sku = sod.sku
